title: Dogfood e2e next-driven loop and rewrite directive docs
description: WHY: the epic is done when an agent can complete real work using only directive output, and when the docs describe the system that exists rather than the matcher that was deleted. WHAT: (1) e2e - on a disposable fixture workspace, file a work order with a declared done-gate, then complete it end to end (claim, implement a trivial change, evidence, verify, close) where every bwrk invocation after the first is taken verbatim from the previous next output; record the full transcript as artifact evidence on this task and attach it to the sprint container. (2) docs - rewrite docs/architecture/AGENT_DIRECTIVES.md around the gap-projection architecture: gap codes as the contract, registry as lookup, safety boundary unchanged, collapsed taxonomy, declared gates, bwrk next; update AGENT_DIRECTIVE_SURFACE_AUDIT.md status and mark superseded sections rather than deleting history. (3) refresh the skill and workflow references that mention directive handling (skills/*/SKILL.md agent-directive sections, workflows/40-work/*.md) so installed adapters match the new output shape.
acceptanceCriteria: Transcript artifact of a fully next-driven loop attached as evidence and referenced from the sprint container
AGENT_DIRECTIVES.md describes the gap-projection architecture with no references to appliesTo matching outside a superseded-design note
Skill and workflow directive-handling sections match the shipped output shape
closedReason: Next-driven dogfood, docs, source adapters, and validation completed.
